summary: One fixed service template reused for every QX service (bookkeeping, payroll, VAT, year-end, accounts): a dark purple page head with a photo, a two-column pitch, a scope table, then proof (logos, video), a difference grid, software logos, FAQ, articles and a contact form. Needs: a scope list, what the client sends, what they get, 6 logos, 5-10 FAQs.

sections.note: dark purple band: small caps tag, big white title, two-line lead, one coral pill button, three tick chips (saving, turnaround, accuracy) below; a photo right inside a rounded frame with a pink shape. The header above is white and sticky.
heading and two or three paragraphs left; three icon rows right (Identify, Analyse, Deliver) each with a round coral icon, a bold word and one line

centered heading and line, then three rows with a label on the left (Scope of work, What we need, What you get) and a pale pink panel on the right holding two columns of short bullets; a round tick joins the rows
dark purple band, about 350px tall: heading with one line of text and one coral pill button on the left, a photo with a big pale number shape on the right
centered heading, one line, a looping row of grey client logos and a centered coral button below
centered heading and one line, then an embedded video player (blank until it loads); about 780px tall
full-width coral band about 315px: centered white heading on two lines and one white button
centered heading and line, eight small icon cards with a short title only, in a 4 by 2 grid
centered heading in the accent colour, one line, a row of six colour logos of accounting software (cloud ledgers and payroll tools)
centered heading and line, one column of 5 to 10 question rows with a chevron, first row closed
centered heading, three article cards with a wide photo and a two-line title
two columns: heading with a line and two icon links (book a virtual meeting, book an in-person meeting) left, a short contact form (names, email, phone, company, source dropdown, message) right
